description: What the daemon-served UI (http://127.0.0.1:7425) may ask the shell for. The page is a remote origin to Tauri, so nothing is allowed unless listed here: dragging the window by its top strip (and zooming it on double-click), the native Save sheet behind ⌘K → 'Back up database to…', and listening for the shell's own events (the ⌥⌘G global hotkey / tray 'Quick capture' emit grimoire:capture; the page cannot emit). Nothing that weakens the review gate is reachable this way.
